title: Manicotti
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the squash and zucchini. Cook, stirring, until the vegetables are browned, about 8 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta, 1 cup of the provolone, the parmesan, eggs, parsley, salt, and pepper. Transfer the cheese mixture to a large resealable storage bag.
Push the mixture toward one corner and twist the bag closed. Make a three-quarter-inch cut in the corner of the bag and squeeze the filling into each pasta tube.

In a bowl, combine the marinara sauce and water. Spread ⅔ cup into each of two 2-quart baking dishes. Divide the manicotti between the baking dishes, arranging in a single layer. Top with the remaining marinara sauce.
Cover one pan with foil and bake for 45 minutes. Remove the foil and sprinkle with ¼ cup provolone cheese. Bake 10 minutes more, or until the cheese melts.
notes: The first instruction step mentions squash, but only zucchini appears in the ingredient list. Yield is 15 manicotti pieces (not servings of people).
